authority: owner ruling 2026-08-22, stated verbatim below and implemented without reinterpretation
status_on_write: QUARANTINED — the contract is the acceptance standard, not a claim that the module meets it. Quarantine lifts only when an INDEPENDENT review kills the mutants, per the owner's instruction.

three_states.rule: Every reported quantity carries exactly one of three states. A structural zero must NEVER render as an observed measurement.
three_states.MEASURED_PAIRED_DELTA: Both arms of the pair were genuinely different and were drawn under identical random numbers. This is the only state that carries a number a reader may treat as a measurement.
three_states.STRUCTURAL_ZERO: The two arms are IDENTICAL by construction, so the difference is 0.0 as an arithmetic fact about the setup, not an observation about starters. Reported as a state with the value 0.0 attached to it, never as a bare 0.0 in a numeric field a reader would read as a measurement.
three_states.NOT_MEASURABLE: The counterfactual could not be formed — a missing, CAP or unregistered starter. Value is null and a reason code is REQUIRED (R1).

required_design.rule: Key simulations by model ID, game ID, scenario and simulation index.
required_design.why: A slate-sequential generator couples games: resolving a starter in game 1 moves the draws of game 9 (the 2026-08-17 coupling defect). A key built from identity rather than position cannot do that.

required_design.rule: Use identical random draws for baseline and counterfactual.
required_design.why: Common random numbers are what make the difference a paired comparison instead of two independent noisy estimates.

required_design.rule: Change away starter only, home starter only, then both.
required_design.why: Three scenarios plus the control give the two main effects and the joint effect.

required_design.rule: Report the interaction separately because joint movement need not equal the sum of individual movements.
required_design.why: Presenting joint as the sum hides the interaction and overstates additivity.
R1. An untreated slot is not a zero effect.
A delta without its simulation uncertainty invites reading noise as signal.

required_design.rule: Describe results as model counterfactual deltas, not real-world causal effects.
required_design.why: The simulator's response to a changed input is not evidence about baseball.

required_design.rule: Scenario order must not change results.
required_design.why: Order-dependence is proof the keying failed.

minimum_falsification_fixtures.must: Improving the home starter moves home probability in the expected direction.
Improving the away starter moves it oppositely.
Reordering games and scenarios changes nothing.
Accidentally changing both starters in a one-starter scenario fails.

quarantine_release_condition: An INDEPENDENT review must kill these mutants. The module's own mutation suite passing is necessary and not sufficient — that is exactly the standing this contract was written to deny (lesson 21). Until then: not imported by healthcheck, not used for any card, grade or decision, numbers not quoted.
